item.title: Visit Keweenaw opens application for 2026 Destination Development Fund
item.description: Visit Keweenaw has opened applications for its 2026 Destination Development Fund. This annual initiative aims to support local groups looking to make an impact the Keweenaw's continued visitor and residential growth, through trail projects, historical displays, and downtown upgrades.

item.title: The Rev. Jesse Jackson Remembered by U.S. Leaders as a National Voice for Justice
item.description: An early follow and mentee of the Rev. Martin Luther King Jr., Jackson became a national voice for justice. Today, leaders in Washington and across the country are honoring his legacy.

item.title: Military Tension Increases Amid Iran Nuclear Negotiations in Geneva
item.description: Tensions are rising again between the United States and Iran, with new threats and military escalation, as high-stakes talks between the two countries take place in Geneva.

item.title: Michigan lawmakers unveil plan to lower housing costs by cutting zoning restrictions
item.description: A bipartisan, bicameral group of Michigan lawmakers has introduced a package of bills aimed at increasing housing supply and lowering costs statewide. The legislation would reform zoning laws, reduce regulatory fees and expand options like duplexes and accessory dwelling units.

item.title: Warm weather drove weekend air quality alerts in southern Michigan
item.description: Unseasonably warm temperatures over a dense snow pack contributed to air quality concerns in parts of southern Michigan this weekend. But officials say an atmospheric inversion — not snowmelt — was the primary reason pollution levels increased.
